2607.11228.title: DeepBias: Adaptive In-depth Probing of Social Biases in LVLMs
2607.11228.paper_summary: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities, they remain highly susceptible to embedded social biases. Existing bias evaluation protocols predominantly rely on static datasets, which provide only a superficial assessment, as their fixed test cases cannot adaptively evolve to measure the true depth and limits of model vulnerabilities. We introduce DeepBias, an adaptive framework for the in-depth probing of social biases in LVLMs with carefully designed agents. Our approach operates through a dynamic ''generation-evolution-probing'' loop. First, a generative ProposerAgent synthesizes test data and is iteratively updated via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) based on the target LVLM's responses, exploring model-specific failure modes. Second, an autonomous skill-driven DiggerAgent rewrites each test data across multiple probing turns, adaptively selecting from a curated skill library of deepening and rewriting strategies. At each turn, this process is conditioned on the model's previous response, enabling progressively deeper biases to be exposed. Furthermore, we build a benchmark named DeepBiasBench using our framework. By employing an ensemble of five diverse state-of-the-art LVLMs as anchors, the benchmark captures vulnerabilities shared across architectures. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework and show that DeepBias provides a challenging benchmark for in-depth bias evaluation, establishing an evolutionary paradigm for LVLM safety assessment.
2607.11228.paper_summary_zh: 雖然大型視覺語言模型（LVLMs）展現出卓越的能力，但它們仍然高度易受內嵌社會偏見的影響。現有的偏見評估協議主要依賴靜態數據集，這僅提供表面的評估，因為它們固定的測試案例無法靈活演變以測量模型脆弱性的真正深度和極限。我們引入了DeepBias，一個用於深入探測LVLMs中社會偏見的自適應框架，並配備精心設計的代理。 我們的方法通過一個動態的「生成-演變-探測」循環運作。首先，生成性提議代理（ProposerAgent）合成測試數據，並根據目標LVLM的反應通過直接偏好優化（DPO）進行迭代更新，探索模型特定的失敗模式。其次，自主技能驅動的挖掘代理（DiggerAgent）在多次探測回合中重寫每個測試數據，自適應地從策劃的技能庫中選擇深化和重寫策略。在每次回合中，這一過程受到模型先前反應的條件限制，使得逐漸更深的偏見得以揭示。此外，我們使用我們的框架建立了一個基準，名為DeepBiasBench。通過使用五個多樣化的最先進LVLM作為錨點，該基準捕捉了跨架構共享的脆弱性。全面的實驗展示了我們框架的有效性，並顯示DeepBias為深入的偏見評估提供了一個具有挑戰性的基準，建立了一個LVLM安全評估的演變範式。
